## Overview

This project demonstrates the use of Quarto for creating:

- **Interactive Notebooks**: Computational notebooks with executable code
- **Presentation Slides**: Professional slides for presentations

## Getting Started

### Notebooks

Explore our sample notebooks:

- [Data Analysis Notebook](notebooks/data-analysis.qmd) - Learn data analysis techniques
- [Python Tutorial](notebooks/python-tutorial.qmd) - Python basics and examples

### Slides

View our presentation slides:

- [Sample Presentation](slides/presentation.qmd) - A demonstration of Quarto slides

## About Quarto

Quarto is an open-source scientific and technical publishing system built on Pandoc. It allows you to create dynamic content with Python, R, Julia, and Observable.

## Building the Project

To render this project, run:

```bash
quarto render
```

To preview the project, run:

```bash
quarto preview
```
